object.name: session_core_manager
object.description: Unprivileged read-only interface for observing active sessions.

s2c.name: session_added
s2c.description: Broadcast to all connected clients when any session is created. Sent once for each already-active session when the manager is first created.

c2s.name: get_session
c2s.description: Creates a `session_core_session` object for the given session_id. The daemon immediately pushes all fields, followed by done. If the session does not exist, destroyed is sent instead.

c2s.name: get_session_by_pid

description.summary: create a per-session info object by leader PID

c2s.description: Creates a session_core_session object for the session whose leader PID matches the given pid. The daemon immediately pushes all fields, followed by done. If no matching session exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: leader PID of the session to query

c2s.name: get_session_by_uid

description.summary: create a per-session info object by user ID

c2s.description: Creates a session_core_session object for the session whose user ID matches the given uid. The daemon immediately pushes all fields, followed by done. If no matching session exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: uid
arg.summary: user ID of the session to query

c2s.name: get_user
c2s.description: Creates a session_core_user object for the given uid. The daemon immediately pushes all fields, followed by done. If uid does not correspond to a known user, not_found is sent instead.

c2s.name: get_seat
c2s.description: Creates a session_core_seat object for the seat with the given name. The daemon immediately pushes the seat fields, followed by done, and re-sends fields as they change. If no matching seat exists, destroyed is sent instead.

s2c.name: can_control_power
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client can reboot, power off, suspend, or hibernate without first closing other users' sessions.

arg.name: can_control_power
arg.summary: non-zero if power operations are currently allowed

object.name: session_core_session
object.description: Provides information about a single session. All fields are pushed immediately on creation and re-sent if they change.

arg.name: timestamp
arg.summary: session start time (seconds since Unix epoch)

arg.name: is_local
arg.summary: non-zero if the session originates from the local machine, zero if remote

arg.name: remote_host
arg.summary: remote host name, empty for local sessions

s2c.name: destroyed

description.summary: session has ended or did not exist

s2c.description: Sent when the session is destroyed or if the `session_id` passed to `get_session` was not found. The client should release this object.

description.summary: send SIGTERM to all processes in the session
forcibly kill all processes in the session via cgroup.kill

s2c.name: can_modify
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client may lock, unlock, terminate, or kill this session.

arg.name: can_modify
arg.summary: non-zero if mutating requests are allowed

object.name: session_core_seat
object.description: Provides information about a single seat. All fields are pushed immediately on creation and re-sent if they change.

arg.name: vt
arg.summary: current virtual terminal, 0 if none or not VT-bound

s2c.name: client_added
s2c.description: Sent once per client during the initial dump and whenever a new client joins the seat. Use get_client with this PID to retrieve the client's status object.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: PID of the client that opened the seat

c2s.name: get_client
c2s.description: Creates a session_core_seat_client object for the client with the given PID on this seat. The daemon immediately pushes the client fields, followed by done, and re-sends fields as they change. If no matching client exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: PID of the client that opened the seat

description.summary: send SIGTERM to all sessions on the seat

s2c.name: destroyed

description.summary: seat has been removed or did not exist

s2c.description: Sent when the seat is destroyed or if the seat name passed to get_seat was not found. The client should release this object.

s2c.name: can_modify
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client may terminate all sessions on this seat.

arg.name: can_modify
arg.summary: non-zero if mutating requests are allowed

object.name: session_core_seat_client
object.description: Provides information about a single client attached to a seat. All fields are pushed immediately on creation and re-sent if they change.

arg.name: active
arg.summary: non-zero if this is the active seat client

arg.name: next
arg.summary: non-zero if this client is queued to become active

arg.name: pid
arg.summary: PID of the client that opened the seat

arg.name: uid
arg.summary: UID of the client that opened the seat

arg.name: gid
arg.summary: GID of the client that opened the seat

s2c.name: device_added
s2c.description: Sent once per device during the initial dump and whenever a new device is assigned to this client. Use get_device with this device_id to retrieve the device status object.

arg.name: device_id
arg.summary: device id scoped to the seat client

arg.name: device_id
arg.summary: device id scoped to the seat client

s2c.name: destroyed

description.summary: seat client has been removed or did not exist

s2c.description: Sent when the client is removed or if the PID passed to get_client was not found. The client should release this object.

c2s.name: get_device
c2s.description: Creates a session_core_seat_device object for the device with the given id on this seat client. The daemon immediately pushes the device fields, followed by done, and re-sends fields as they change. If no matching device exists, destroyed is sent instead.

arg.name: device_id
arg.summary: device id scoped to the seat client

object.name: session_core_seat_device
object.description: Provides information about a single device assigned to a seat client. All fields are pushed immediately on creation and re-sent if they change.

arg.name: device_id
arg.summary: device id scoped to the seat client

arg.name: active
arg.summary: non-zero if this device is currently active

s2c.name: destroyed

description.summary: seat device has been removed or did not exist

s2c.description: Sent when the device is removed or if the device_id passed to get_device was not found. The client should release this object.

object.name: session_core_user
object.description: Provides information about a single user, identified by uid. All fields are pushed immediately on creation, followed by done.

arg.name: lingering
arg.summary: non-zero if the user has lingering enabled

s2c.name: state
s2c.description: Reflects whether the user currently has sessions and whether any of them is in the foreground, combined with the lingering flag. Re-sent whenever it changes.

s2c.name: not_found
s2c.description: Sent when the uid passed to get_user does not correspond to a known user. The client should release this object.

s2c.name: can_modify
s2c.description: Non-zero if this client may terminate or kill this user's sessions.

arg.name: can_modify
arg.summary: non-zero if mutating requests are allowed

value.name: online
value.summary: has a session, none in the foreground

value.name: active
value.summary: has a session in the foreground

value.name: closing
value.summary: has sessions, all of them closing

value.name: online
value.summary: session is logged in but not in the foreground

value.name: user
value.summary: interactive login session owned by a user

value.name: greeter
value.summary: login prompt or display manager session

value.name: lock_screen
value.summary: screen locker session associated with an existing login

value.name: background
value.summary: non-interactive user session without an attached seat or VT

value.name: background_light
value.summary: lightweight background session excluded from idle shutdown accounting

value.name: manager_early
value.summary: early per-user service manager session created before a regular login

value.name: vt_bound
value.summary: seat follows the active virtual terminal

value.name: non_vt_bound
value.summary: seat is not bound to virtual terminals
